title: Mechanism Analysis of Zuogui and Yougui Pills on Diabetic Nephropathy Through Transcriptional Regulatory Networks of HIF1A and PPARA.
authors: Qiao, Liansheng; Zhao, Xiaopeng; Yuan, Anlei; Liu, Chaoqun; Wang, Zewen; Huo, Xiaoqian; Bi, Shijie; Tian, Jiaye; Yu, Bin; Lin, Zhaozhou; Zhang, Yanling; Zhang, Jiwang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过HIF1A/PPARA转录调控网络治疗糖尿病肾病，虽涉及转录因子与下游基因调控及分子对接，但核心是疾病机制与药物靶点，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，方法以实验和简单对接为主，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: Diabetic nephropathy, a serious diabetes complication, lacks effective treatments. Traditional Chinese medicine Zuogui Pill (ZGP) and Yougui Pill (YGP) have a definite clinical adjunctive effect on diabetic nephropathy. Given their similar compositions, studying their shared mechanisms could provide novel perspectives into discovering therapeutic targets for diabetic nephropathy. Extraction of ZGP (EZP) and YGP (EYP) was prepared by in vitro digestion. EZP and EYP inhibited the gene expression of FN1 and MMP9 in a renal fibrosis cell model. A transcriptional regulatory network revealed EZP and EYP have similar mechanisms, with HIF1A as a key transcription factor. In an insulin resistance cell model, EZP and EYP led to the decrease in glucose consumption. A transcriptional regulatory network suggested that EZP and EYP have different regulatory panels, but PPARA was the common transcriptional factor. CA9 and PDK1, the downstream genes of HIF1A, and PDK4, the downstream gene of PPARA, were activated by both EZP and EYP, which showed the potential new targets of diabetic nephropathy. A total of 42 compounds from EZP and EYP were screened as the potential mediators of HIF1AN and EGLN1, interacted proteins and common targets of HIF1A. A total of 8 compounds, including verbascoside, were screened as the potential PPARA agonists based on molecular docking. Verbascoside improved the decrease in glucose consumption. The study clarified the mechanism of the ZGP and YGP by regulating the transcriptional regulatory network of HIF1A and PPARA and provided new ideas for the discovery of potential targets for the treatment of diabetic nephropathy and the development of natural nutrients.
abstract_zh: 糖尿病肾病（diabetic nephropathy）是糖尿病的严重并发症，目前缺乏有效治疗方法。传统中药左归丸（Zuogui Pill, ZGP）和右归丸（Yougui Pill, YGP）对糖尿病肾病具有明确的临床辅助疗效。鉴于两者组成相似，研究其共同机制可为发现糖尿病肾病的治疗靶点提供新视角。通过体外消化制备了左归丸提取物（EZP）和右归丸提取物（EYP）。在肾纤维化细胞模型中，EZP和EYP抑制了FN1和MMP9的基因表达。转录调控网络显示，EZP和EYP具有相似机制，其中HIF1A是关键转录因子。在胰岛素抵抗细胞模型中，EZP和EYP导致葡萄糖消耗减少。转录调控网络提示，EZP和EYP具有不同的调控面板，但PPARA是共同转录因子。HIF1A的下游基因CA9和PDK1，以及PPARA的下游基因PDK4，均被EZP和EYP激活，这显示了糖尿病肾病的潜在新靶点。从EZP和EYP中筛选出共42种化合物，作为HIF1AN和EGLN1（HIF1A的相互作用蛋白和共同靶点）的潜在介导因子。基于分子对接（molecular docking），共筛选出8种化合物（包括毛蕊花糖苷 (verbascoside)）作为潜在的PPARA激动剂。毛蕊花糖苷改善了葡萄糖消耗的减少。本研究阐明了ZGP和YGP通过调控HIF1A和PPARA的转录调控网络发挥作用的机制，并为发现糖尿病肾病治疗的潜在靶点及开发天然营养素提供了新思路。
